description: LinkedIn conversion image pixels on px.ads.linkedin.com/collect. Campaign Manager generates pid, conversionId, and fmt. eventId is the dedup key LinkedIn documents on the image URL. Insight Tag page-load fires omit conversionId. CAPI stays vendor/linkedin-conversions-api.

params.name: pid
params.description: It is the numeric Partner ID of the Insight Tag. LinkedIn generates this pixel in Campaign Manager rather than publishing the parameter contract, so this rule is ecosystem evidence, not a published contract.
params.fix_hint: Copy the image pixel from the conversion's Sources page so `pid` carries the Partner ID.

params.name: conversionId
params.description: Without it the fire is attributed to the Insight Tag rather than to a specific conversion. Page-load noscript tags omit it on purpose.
params.fix_hint: Add the numeric conversion ID from Campaign Manager.

params.name: fmt
params.description: Image pixels are generated with `fmt=gif`. LinkedIn's conversion API sample uses `fmt=img`.

params.name: eventId
params.description: It is the per-event deduplication key. LinkedIn documents it on the image URL as eventId when the same conversion is also sent through the Conversions API.
params.fix_hint: Set eventId to the same value the Conversions API event sends as event_id.
